_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/costs/test_pay_any_amount.py. t_any_red_tyrant is Leyline Tyrant on a smaller body: it keeps red mana, and when it dies its controller may pay any amount of {R}; when they do, it deals that much damage to any target.

cards.name: Test Any Red Tyrant
cards.oracle_text:
You don't lose unspent red mana as steps and phases end.
When this creature dies, you may pay any amount of {R}. When you do, it deals that much damage to any target.
